learning_outcomes.text: Understand and explain the basics, principles, and application areas of “Artificial Intelligence” and “Machine Learning” (ML).
Prepare and process data for ML models.
Apply and evaluate supervised learning methods and various classification and regression algorithms.
Implement and train Neural Networks and Deep Learning models.
Use unsupervised learning methods such as clustering and dimensionality reduction.
Understand basic concepts of reinforcement learning.
Understand basic concepts of generative AI.
Effectively use ML frameworks and libraries.
Recognize and discuss ethical and societal implications of AI and ML.
Acquire knowledge in new subject areas.
Assess and discuss the impact of key technologies.

syllabus_topics: Basics: Concepts and applications of AI technologies
Difference between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning methods
Cost function and gradient descent methods
Artificial neurons and simple feed-forward networks
Advanced techniques and deep neural networks (CNNs, Transformers)
Students can understand the functionality of software tools.
Students are able to break down complex problems into sub-problems.
Students are able to abstract and systematically process tasks.
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the written examination (Klausurarbeit) must be passed. Regular attendance at the course is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
